Loss report: gitlab -> drone
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/triggered job.if (the triggers of the pipeline have no single Drone condition; the document never runs)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/triggered/step/script step.shell (Drone compiles commands into its own set -e script that runs under /bin/sh; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.api (the document is disabled, so the trigger is not written)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/triggered job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
